title: The 5 Best Dog Beds Under $60
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for dog beds under $60, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dog beds under $60 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Furhaven Ultra Plush Luxe Lounger Medium
products.blurb: Key specs: Contour mattress shape for dogs up to 23 pounds, Ultra-plush faux fur and suede cover, Removable, machine-washable cover.
strengths: Genuine contour foam base rather than pure fiber fill at this price
Washable cover extends usable life well past a year of daily use
Same Furhaven construction quality found in the brand's larger, pricier sizes
limitations: Sized for dogs up to 23 pounds, not a fit for medium or large breeds
Foam is thinner than Furhaven's larger jumbo-size beds
Cover fabric shows wear faster than a bonded microfiber cover
features: Contour mattress shape for dogs up to 23 pounds
Ultra-plush faux fur and suede cover

products.name: Furhaven Plush & Suede Sofa-Style Medium
products.blurb: Key specs: Sofa-style bolster edge for dogs up to 35 pounds, Removable bolsters and washable cover, Plush and suede fabric combination.
strengths: Raised bolster edge suits dogs that like to rest their head or curl against a wall
Fits dogs up to 35 pounds, a bit more room than the smallest Furhaven sizes
Removable bolster pieces make full cover washing easier than one-piece designs
limitations: Bolster edges take up sleeping surface a dog that sprawls flat won't use
Foam under the bolsters compresses faster than the flat sleeping area
Not a fit for dogs over roughly 35 pounds
features: Sofa-style bolster edge for dogs up to 35 pounds

products.name: Furhaven Medium CertiPUR Foam Sofa Bed
products.blurb: Key specs: CertiPUR-US certified foam, 30 by 20-inch medium size, Embossed velvet removable cover.
strengths: CertiPUR-US certification confirms the foam meets independent content and emissions standards
Embossed velvet cover feels more durable than basic plush fabric at this price
30 by 20-inch size fits most medium dogs comfortably
limitations: Still a fiber-and-foam hybrid rather than a solid orthopedic slab
Fewer total reviews than Furhaven's more established Luxe Lounger line
Not rated for dogs over medium size

limitations: Foam can flatten with heavy use
